# Classic, frozen: the files classic cmux customers depend on. Don't touch them until Leo decides the migration.
#
# Leo, 2026-11-04: "is it possible to HARD MARK certain files or whatever as like "classic, don't touch until we
# decide to do the migration"" and "for next related paths, only look there / simply skip the old code".
#
# A pull request into feat-cmux-next or main that changes a frozen path fails the classic-frozen-guard check
# (scripts/ci/classic_frozen_guard.py, .github/workflows/classic-frozen-guard.yml) unless it carries the label
# `classic-migration`, which is Leo's decision to add. NEXT work never reads, greps or builds on these files:
# NEXT Cloud backend code goes to manaflow-ai/cmux-platform. The same file is on feat-cmux-next and main.
#
# One rule per line: GLOB SCOPE REASON. `**` crosses directories, `*` stays within one segment. SCOPE is `all`
# (frozen into feat-cmux-next and main) or `main` (frozen into main only: on feat-cmux-next the same path is NEXT's,
# like the NEXT devbox image under web/services/vms that cloud-devbox-image-rebake.yml bakes).
#
# Not classic, and not frozen: NEXT code that calls classic (CloudAPIClient.swift's /api/vm routes,
# CloudClassicPageOps.swift), cmux-api (backend/apps/api) and workers/cmux-vm.

# Leo, 2026-11-05: "when it's on the Feet CMux next branch, you can delete code. Like the classic cloud code, you can
# just delete it" and "it's, like, fine enough to just delete it for now on the branch". feat-cmux-next is to become
# main by a rename, so classic Cloud deleted here never merges into production main. A rule whose files are gone from
# feat-cmux-next is `main` here; main's copy of this file keeps its own scopes.

# cmux.com's classic API, served by the Vercel project in web/ (web/vercel.json deploys every push to main).
web/app/api/**                     all   classic cmux.com /api: /api/vm, /api/runs, account, billing, teams, cron
web/app/v1/**                      all   classic public /v1 API
web/app/vm/**                      main  classic VM pages customers open (deleted on feat-cmux-next)
web/app/handler/**                 all   classic sign-in handler (Stack)
web/app/authorize/**               all   classic OAuth authorize flow
web/services/runs/model.ts         all   classic Run model; kept on feat-cmux-next because NEXT's web/services/vms reads it
web/services/runs/**               main  classic /api/runs backend (deleted on feat-cmux-next)
web/services/billing/**            all   classic billing and Stripe webhooks
web/services/vm-publications/**    all   classic VM publications backend
web/db/**                          all   classic Postgres schema and migrations (customers' data)
web/orpc/**                        all   classic oRPC API
web/openapi/**                     all   classic OpenAPI contract
web/proxy.ts                       all   classic request proxy on cmux.com
web/vercel.json                    all   classic Vercel deploy config (what deploys from main)

# Classic Cloud workflows: they run classic /api/vm and its devbox image, not NEXT.
# Main only: feat-cmux-next's cloud-vm-dogfood.yml runs NEXT's cmux VM API (#35042), and the other three are not there.
.github/workflows/cloud-vm-dogfood.yml    main  classic /api/vm dogfood journey (checks out main's web/)
.github/workflows/cloud-vm-canary.yml     main  classic /api/vm canary every 5 minutes
.github/workflows/cloud-vm-smoke.yml      main  classic /api/vm smoke
.github/workflows/cloud-vm-env-audit.yml  main  classic Vercel env audit

# Into main, all of web/ is classic: the Vercel project behind cmux.com and its /api, the classic VM drivers
# (web/services/vms) and the classic devbox image (web/services/vms/images, web/scripts/build-devbox-freestyle.ts).
# Every push to main deploys it. On feat-cmux-next, web/services/vms and its image are NEXT's, so these are main only.
web/**                                       main  classic cmux.com Vercel project, VM drivers and devbox image
config/iroh/managed-relay-catalog.json       main  ships in classic cmux.com's API (classic-auto-deploy.json)
workers/presence/src/generated/managedRelayCatalog.ts  main  generated from the classic relay catalog

# The freeze itself: what is frozen is Leo's call, so changing this list needs the label too.
.github/classic-frozen.txt                   all   the classic-frozen list
.github/workflows/classic-frozen-guard.yml   all   the check that enforces the list
scripts/ci/classic_frozen_guard.py           all   the check that enforces the list
